name: [R7] Rapid multi-tool security tooling execution by one parent
description: One parent process spawning many DISTINCT security tools in a short window — the behavioral core of autonomous AI pentest agents (E2E agents, and MCP frameworks orchestrating 150+ tools). Persists even with a LOCAL LLM and no egress (R1). Threshold rule keyed on process.parent.entity_id with a cardinality floor on process.name; tune the cardinality value to your baseline.
query: process.name:("nmap" or "ffuf" or "gobuster" or "nikto" or "sqlmap" or "hydra" or "nuclei" or "wpscan" or "msfconsole" or "medusa" or "enum4linux")
author: ai-agent-attack-defense
false_positives: Authorized scanning pipelines / scheduled security scans — allowlist the orchestrator.
A human pentester working fast — correlate with authorization/scope.
